comparison.objective: Select a sufficiently high-friction liner and stabilize a glass on an incline, versus tune and lock a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Material selection and released glass placement differ from fine tool insertion, captive-screw manipulation, collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and iterative impact adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Success requires stable released glass placement for 10/20 seconds without bracing; the candidate requires two bounded dynamic stops and collar retention within 2 degrees.
comparison.reason: Both evaluate physical response after selection, but static friction testing and placement do not duplicate mechanical commissioning or locking.
